# sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

We released `sqlpipe` v2.0. This version includes breaking changes, new features, and speed improvements.

## Breaking Changes

- The `/v2/users` endpoint no longer contains the `name` field.
- We split the `name` field into `first_name` and `last_name`.
- If you query `/v2/users`, you must update your code to use `first_name` and `last_name`.
- If you send the `name` field in a request, the API returns an error.

## New Features

- We added the `--incremental` flag to the command-line tool.
- When you export data, you can use the `--incremental` flag.
- If you set the `--incremental` flag, `sqlpipe` processes only new data records.

## Performance Improvements

- Parquet file writes are 40% faster in v2.0.
- We optimized memory allocations in the Parquet exporter.
- Because we optimized memory allocations, you can write large files faster.
